generation.method: Deterministic authored variation in local dates, arrival/check-in times, observation and reply lead times, companion assignments and 2–4 causal request/acknowledgment/reply histories per run, executed through the public plugin.

provenance.statement: All hotel, traveler, source, request, reply and event records are authored fiction. The fixed property and three-person pool implement the approved one-property/two-guest scope; dates, assignments, timing and causal histories vary independently across isolated runs. No real-data anchor is claimed or required.
provenance.future_dates: Dates after authoring are explicitly synthetic prospective scenarios, never observations of actual future activity.
provenance.record_identity: scenario_id plus record_type plus record id; App-local IDs are intentionally reused only across isolated runs.
